description: Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha - Declared as Road and Lanes Owned by the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules with land coordinates, measurements, and property boundaries. The content focuses on land ownership rights, property boundaries, and legal procedures for claiming land ownership, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
